Items served: a curry-style dish of chicken or pork with potatoes (large portion, ~350 g, ~450 kcal), shredded chocolate or meat (the dark pile, likely shredded braised beef, ~100 g, ~200 kcal), cannelloni/crepe (~200 g, ~350 kcal), fruit salad (~150 g, ~80 kcal), brownie (~60 g, ~250 kcal), chocolate bar (~30 g, ~150 kcal), orange juice (~200 ml, ~90 kcal), and cola (~250 ml, ~105 kcal).

Total served: about 1675 kcal.

Left over: some curry (~60 g, ~80 kcal), about 40% of the cannelloni (~140 kcal), about half the fruit (~35 kcal, mostly apple left), and the wrapper of the chocolate bar (the bar was eaten). The brownie, shredded meat, and drinks were finished. Total left over: about 255 kcal.

Eaten: 1675 − 255 = 1420 kcal.

Macros, estimated from the eaten portion: protein ~65 g, carbs ~170 g, fat ~55 g (65×4 + 170×4 + 55×9 = 260 + 680 + 495 ≈ 1435 kcal, consistent).
